steps_per_round: min(500,ceil(eligible new windows / 8)); final round collection only
value_head: masked-mean prefix hidden states -> LayerNorm -> Linear256 SiLU -> sigmoid
value_fit: one shuffled epoch over current and replay windows, BCE, AdamW lr1e-3, batch256; retained across rounds
beta: population standard deviation of current+replay advantages; floor1e-6
action_targets: actual executed native actions, normalized with original input transform
terminal_padding: masked; never treated as executed actions
evaluation: pre-update EMA collection success; no separate evaluation; final round collection only
rollout_initial_states: 50 native states, round-seeded permutation; stochastic policy noise
cache_retention: all current windows until results durable; reservoir2000 of all completed windows; other consumed KV deleted
replay_sampling: uniform reservoir over eligible online windows only
operator_shadow: every request; same sampling noise as production
takeover_trigger: first5 cumulative OSC target positions mean Euclidean distance >0.02m OR displacement<=0.002m over20steps
training_data: intervention action frames plus entirely autonomous successful episodes
